description: Canonical machine-readable error code registry for StellarCred smart contracts.

proof_registry.name: ProofRegistry
proof_registry.description: On-chain verification and proof registry caching verified claims and enforcing issuer trust.

1.name: NotInitialized
1.description: Contracts not initialised - required contract addresses or admin state are unset.
1.retryGuidance: Deploy and initialise the contract before invoking functions.

2.name: VerificationFailed
2.description: Proof verification failed - the ZK proof is invalid or was generated against the wrong circuit VK.
2.retryGuidance: Do not retry with the same proof. Regenerate the ZK proof using matching circuit verification keys.

3.name: NotAuthorized
3.description: Not authorised - wallet signature missing or wrong account.
3.retryGuidance: Check that the calling wallet matches the required identity and provide valid authorization.

4.name: IssuerNotTrusted
4.description: Issuer not trusted - the issuer address is not registered for this credential type.
4.retryGuidance: Verify the credential issuer against the IssuerRegistry before submitting.

5.name: IssuerKeyMismatch
5.description: Issuer key mismatch - this credential was signed with a key that does not match what is registered on-chain.
5.retryGuidance: Re-issue the credential with the current registered issuer signing key and try again.

6.name: ProofNotFound
6.description: Proof not found - no on-chain proof exists for this holder and credential type.
6.retryGuidance: Submit a valid proof before attempting to query or consume the claim.

7.name: BatchTooLarge
7.description: Batch too large - the submission exceeds the maximum batch limit.
7.retryGuidance: Reduce the batch size and submit in smaller chunks.

8.name: BatchEmpty
8.description: Batch is empty - at least one proof submission is required.
8.retryGuidance: Include one or more proof submissions in the batch.

9.name: DuplicateCredentialType
9.description: Duplicate credential type - the batch contains multiple proofs for the same claim type.
9.retryGuidance: Deduplicate submissions in the batch so each credential type appears at most once.

10.name: AggregateLayoutInvalid
10.description: Aggregate proof layout invalid - the number of credentials or public inputs do not match expected format.
10.retryGuidance: Re-generate the aggregate proof with the canonical public input ordering.

11.name: SubmissionsPaused
11.description: Submissions paused - protocol admin has temporarily halted new proof submissions.
11.retryGuidance: Transient state. Wait for the pauser or admin to resume submissions before retrying.

12.name: InvalidExpiry
12.description: Invalid expiry - the credential expiry is either in the past or exceeds the maximum allowable future window.
12.retryGuidance: Re-issue the credential with an expiry timestamp within valid limits.

13.name: RoleNotHeld
13.description: Caller does not hold the required role for this administrative function.
13.retryGuidance: Ensure the transaction is signed with an address granted the appropriate role.

14.name: RoleHolderMismatch
14.description: revoke_role named an address that is not the current holder of the role.
14.retryGuidance: Query role holders to inspect the active address before attempting revocation.

15.name: NoPendingAdmin
15.description: accept_admin was called when no pending admin proposal exists.
15.retryGuidance: The existing admin must call propose_admin before the new admin can accept.

16.name: NullifierAlreadyUsed
16.description: The nullifier has already been consumed in this application context.
16.retryGuidance: A credential proof cannot be double-spent. Generate a new proof with an unused nullifier if supported.

issuer_registry.name: IssuerRegistry
issuer_registry.description: Trust root managing recognized credential issuers and rotating public keys.

1.name: NotInitialized
1.description: IssuerRegistry has not been initialized with admin state.
1.retryGuidance: Run contract constructor and initialize state before usage.

2.name: IssuerNotFound
2.description: The specified issuer address is not registered in the system.
2.retryGuidance: Register the issuer address via admin before querying or updating.

3.name: MetadataTooLong
3.description: Issuer metadata string exceeds maximum permitted length.
3.retryGuidance: Shorten name, url, or logo metadata payloads within the maximum byte limit.

4.name: RoleNotHeld
4.description: Caller does not hold the required administrative role for this operation.
4.retryGuidance: Execute the transaction with an address holding the required role.

5.name: RoleHolderMismatch
5.description: revoke_role address does not match the active holder.
5.retryGuidance: Confirm the current assigned role holder address before revoking.

6.name: KeyNotFound
6.description: The public key is not part of this issuer live key set.
6.retryGuidance: Verify the key was previously registered and that its validity window has not closed.

7.name: KeyAlreadyRevoked
7.retryGuidance: No action needed; the key is already inactive.

8.name: KeyAlreadyRetired
8.description: rotate_issuer_key attempted to install a key that is already retired.
8.retryGuidance: Provide a fresh, previously unused secp256k1 public key for rotation.

9.name: KeyHistoryFull
9.description: Issuer retains maximum number of retired keys inside active validity windows.
9.retryGuidance: Wait for older retired keys to pass their validity window before rotating again.

10.name: InvalidKeyWindow
10.description: Requested key validity window is zero or exceeds maximum retention limit.
10.retryGuidance: Specify a validity window between 1 second and MAX_KEY_RETENTION_SECS.

11.name: KeyAlreadyCurrent
11.description: rotate_issuer_key was asked to install the key that is already active.
11.retryGuidance: Provide a new public key distinct from the current key.

12.name: KeyChangeRequiresRotation
12.description: register_issuer attempted to change the pubkey of an existing issuer.
12.retryGuidance: Use rotate_issuer_key so existing credentials remain verifiable within their validity window.

13.name: NoPendingAdmin
13.description: accept_admin was called with no pending admin proposal.
13.retryGuidance: Admin must call propose_admin before accept_admin can succeed.

credential_verifier.name: CredentialVerifier
credential_verifier.description: Stateless verification contract executing host-native BN254 UltraHonk proof checks.

1.name: NotInitialized
1.retryGuidance: Initialize the verifier contract with admin address.

2.name: VkNotSet
2.description: No verification key is registered for the specified credential type and version.
2.retryGuidance: Register the circuit verification key before submitting proofs.

3.name: VkInvalid
3.description: The verification key bytes are malformed or fail integrity checks.
3.retryGuidance: Re-extract verification key from compiled circuit artifacts and re-register.

4.name: VersionDeprecated
4.description: The requested VK version has been deprecated by admin.
4.retryGuidance: Upgrade to the latest circuit version and submit proofs against the current VK.

5.name: VkAlreadySet
5.description: A verification key is already registered at the requested version. VKs are immutable.
5.retryGuidance: Increment the version number and register as a new version.

6.name: VkStillReferenceable
6.description: VK version cannot be purged while still referenceable by valid cached proofs.
6.retryGuidance: Wait until all cached proofs referencing this version have expired.

7.name: RoleNotHeld
7.description: Caller does not hold the required role for this verifier function.
7.retryGuidance: Invoke with an address granted the required role.

8.name: RoleHolderMismatch
8.description: revoke_role target address is not the current holder.
8.retryGuidance: Verify current role holder before attempting revocation.

9.name: NoPendingAdmin
9.description: accept_admin called without an active proposal.
9.retryGuidance: Admin must call propose_admin prior to accept_admin.

gated_pool.name: GatedPool
gated_pool.description: Demo DeFi pool gated on zero-knowledge KYC and claim verification.

1.name: NotInitialized
1.retryGuidance: Call constructor to set registry and required claim types.

2.name: NotKycVerified
2.description: Caller does not possess a valid verified claim in ProofRegistry.
2.retryGuidance: Complete credential verification and submit proof to ProofRegistry before joining the pool.

3.name: InvalidAmount
3.description: Deposit or withdrawal amount must be greater than zero.
3.retryGuidance: Specify a positive non-zero token amount.

4.name: InsufficientBalance
4.description: Withdrawal amount exceeds caller deposited balance.
4.retryGuidance: Request an amount less than or equal to current deposited balance.
